home.name: James Reimer
home.news: After Igor Shesterkin's season-ending injury, the Rangers have leaned heavily on rookie Dylan Garand, who has been serviceable. Still, they will welcome veteran James Reimer into their crease after signing him following a successful PTO. The 38-year-old Reimer was excellent in his only game with Hartford (AHL), recording a 35-save shutout victory. The Ottawa Senators signed Reimer under similar circumstances last season, where he posted a 2.42 GAA and .886 SV% in 14 appearances (7-4-2). The Rangers enter Monday's contest as -126 home favourites against a Los Angeles Kings team that has scored fewer than two goals in seven straight games (2-4-1).

home.name: Devin Cooley
home.news: Cooley emerged as a 28-year-old rookie in the 2025-26 season, posting a 2.69 GAA and .909 SV% in 31 games (10-10-6) for a defensively porous Calgary Flames team. He hoped to carry that momentum into the 2026-27 season, but started on a sour note, allowing 10 goals on 55 shots (.818 SV%) in his first two games (0-2-0). That said, Cooley has rebounded, being nearly unbeatable, saving 100 of 104 shots (.962 SV%) in three games since (3-0-0). The Flames enter Monday's contest as +131 home underdogs against a Toronto Maple Leafs team that has scored 21 goals during a four-game winning streak.
